# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go to the latest release of the current major version, and to
the latest release of an older major while its `{major}.x` branch still gets
releases.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue.

Report it privately through GitHub: go to the
[Security tab](https://github.com/alopia/signy/security) and click
**Report a vulnerability**.

You should get a reply within 7 days. Once we confirm the issue, we publish
a fix and an advisory that credits you, unless you ask us not to.
